# typecheck's fetch (.github/workflows/ci-job-typecheck.yaml): the modules its two vets of the
# daemon module load, each with -test since a vet reads the tests too: linux with the e2e tag,
# and darwin/arm64 with each tag set .github/scripts/go_build_tags.py prints for it (one today).
# A new tag set there is a new line here, or the darwin vet names the module it cannot load.
deps packages/daemon -test -tags e2e ./...
GOOS=darwin GOARCH=arm64 deps packages/daemon -test -tags e2e ./...
